name: Babylon
description: Babylon is the ruined capital of the Neo-Babylonian Empire, standing beside the Euphrates about 85 km south of Baghdad in Iraq. Walk among its mud-brick remains of city walls, gates, palaces and temples, once ruled by kings such as Hammurabi and Nebuchadnezzar. Its name is forever tied to the legendary Hanging Gardens, one of the Seven Wonders of the ancient world.
